preamble: Chapter rule 1: A fish, crustacean, mollusc or other aquatic invertebrate obtained in the territory of a USMCA country is originating even if obtained from eggs, larvae, fry, fingerlings, parr, smolts or other immature fish at a post-larval stage that are imported from a non-USMCA country.

rules.text: A change to headings 0301 through 0305 from any other chapter.

(A) A change to a smoked good of subheadings 0306.11 through 0308.90 from a non-smoked good within those subheadings or any other subheading; or
(B) A change to any other good of subheadings 0306.11 through 0308.90 from any other chapter.
